vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.9

The tickerdb skill bundle is a legitimate integration for the TickerDB market intelligence service. The SKILL.md file provides detailed instructions for an AI agent to handle authentication via email/OTP, manage a server-side watchlist, and perform complex market searches using the api.tickerdb.com endpoints. The authentication flow and the use of environment variables (TICKERDB_KEY) are transparently documented and aligned with the service's stated purpose. There are no signs of data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with a TickerDB API integration: it only asks for a TICKERDB_KEY and describes expected API calls and onboarding flows, with no unrelated access or install steps.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (querying TickerDB for categorical market data) matches the declared requirement (TICKERDB_KEY) and the SKILL.md which documents API endpoints and data formats. No unrelated cloud or system credentials are requested.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to perform an email-based auth flow (POST /auth and /auth/verify) and to show/save the returned apiKey. That is coherent with onboarding for a user API key, but the skill does instruct the agent to collect the user's email and verification code and to offer persisting the API key — the user should explicitly consent to persisting credentials.

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for accessing TickerDB. Before installing: 1) Confirm you trust tickerdb.com and are OK with providing and storing an API key; the skill's onboarding asks for your email and a 6-digit verification code and will offer to persist the returned apiKey. 2) Prefer creating a limited-scope API key on TickerDB (if available) rather than reusing a high-privilege key. 3) Ask the skill to not persist credentials if you prefer entering the key per-session. 4) Review TickerDB's dashboard and docs to understand what the key can access (watchlists/webhooks/daily reports) and revoke it if needed. 5) Note the skill is instruction-only (no installers), and it will run autonomously when invoked by the agent — ensure you only grant access you’re comfortable storing on this platform.
